Director, Operations provides strategic and operational leadership by setting the manufacturing vision across departments and overseeing the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of pharmaceutical manufacturing processes.

* Ensure effective Operations and Quality controls are in place to meet sterile manufacturing requirements.
* Deliver production targets, efficiency metrics, and on-time customer supply.
